run.sql: SELECT name,column_id,system_type_id,user_type_id,max_length,precision,scale,collation_name,is_nullable,is_computed FROM sys.all_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'sys.databases') AND name IN (N'name',N'database_id',N'source_database_id',N'create_date',N'compatibility_level',N'collation_name',N'user_access',N'user_access_desc',N'is_read_only',N'state',N'state_desc',N'recovery_model',N'recovery_model_desc') ORDER BY column_id
